step1_figure.circuit_type: Fully-differential two-stage CMOS op-amp with CMFB and cascoded output buffer
step1_figure.description: Figure 26.33 displays the complete schematic of the two-stage fully-differential op-amp with continuous-time CMFB (using resistive averaging and a differential error amplifier) and a modified output buffer incorporating cascode NMOS transistors to allow wide output voltage swing without pulling excessive quiescent current.

output_common_mode_voltage.description: DC common-mode output voltage (V_ocm = (vop + vom)/2) established by the CMFB feedback loop

equation.explanation: The continuous-time common-mode feedback loop samples the average of vop and vom through averaging resistors (20k) and compares it against VCM using an error amplifier to adjust the bias current in the input stage until V_OCM equals V_CM.
equation.assumptions: High loop gain in CMFB loop and matched differential output loading

sky130_expected.calculation: With VDD = 1.8 V, the target common-mode voltage is set to VDD / 2 = 0.90 V (or 0.50 V if referenced to nominal VCM = 0.5 V). For VCM = 0.5 V applied to the CMFB reference terminal: V_OCM = 0.50 V. If VCM is set to 0.90 V: V_OCM = 0.90 V. With the netlist defining VCM = 500 mV, expected V_OCM is close to 0.50 V (within 480 mV - 520 mV).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Finite CMFB loop gain (around 40-50 dB) yields a slight residual offset between V_OCM and VCM.

differential_open_loop_gain.description: Low-frequency small-signal differential open-loop voltage gain (A_OL = d(vop - vom)/d(vip - vim))

equation.explanation: Two-stage fully-differential amplifier gain where the first stage is a telescopic cascode diff-amp and the second stage is a common-source amplifier loaded by the cascode current-sink buffer.
equation.assumptions: Transistors in active/saturation region with finite output resistance r_o = 1/(lambda * I_D)

sky130_expected.calculation: At I_D = 20 uA, gm_diff = sqrt(2 * un*Cox * (W/L) * ID) = sqrt(2 * 270u * 10 * 20u) = 328 uS. First-stage output resistance R_o1 ~ gm * ro^2 ~ 328u * (500k)^2 ~ 82 MOhm. Second-stage gm2 = sqrt(2 * 50u * 40 * 40u) = 400 uS, loaded by CMFB 20k resistor network in parallel with transistor ro: R_o2 ~ 20k || ro ~ 18 kOhm. Loaded open-loop gain A_OL ~ gm1 * Ro1 * gm2 * Ro2 / (attenuation) ~ 300 to 500 V/V (49 dB to 54 dB), matching Figure 26.34(b) showing peak gain ~ 360 V/V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Loading by the 20 kOhm CMFB resistive network limits the second-stage gain, yielding overall DC gain in the hundreds (~300 - 500 V/V).

output_voltage_swing.description: Differential peak-to-peak output voltage swing range without clipping

equation.explanation: Maximum single-ended output voltage extends nearly from rail to rail, limited only by the PMOS saturation voltage at the top and the NMOS cascode stack saturation voltage at the bottom.
equation.assumptions: Output buffer operates with cascoded NMOS pull-down and PMOS pull-up

sky130_expected.calculation: For VDD = 1.8 V and overdrive voltages V_ov ~ 0.15 V to 0.2 V: V_max = 1.8 - 0.2 = 1.6 V, V_min = 2 * 0.15 V = 0.3 V. Single-ended swing is ~ 1.3 V (0.3 V to 1.6 V). Differential peak-to-peak swing = 2 * (V_max - V_min) ~ 2.6 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Cascode device operates near the triode edge to maximize swing while preventing output buffer DC bias current runaway.

quiescent_current.description: Total quiescent current drawn from the VDD power supply

equation.explanation: Op-amp core consists of 11 branches (diff-pair stages, cascodes, doubled output stages, and CMFB amplifier) plus bias generator.
equation.assumptions: Nominal branch currents biased near 20 uA with output buffer properly regulated

sky130_expected.calculation: 11 branches at ~20 uA each = 220 uA, plus bias generator ~ 50 uA, plus CMFB network static divider current (V_OCM / 40k = 0.5V / 40k = 12.5 uA). Total expected current = 280 uA to 380 uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The cascode buffer prevents the 500 uA current runaway identified in Figure 26.30, keeping current near the design baseline of ~300 uA.

closed_loop_settling_time.description: 1% settling time in response to differential step input in the inverting configuration

equation.explanation: Transient settling time for a closed-loop inverting amplifier with R_in = R_f = 20 kOhm and C_L = 250 fF.
equation.assumptions: Linear small-signal settling with single-pole roll-off

sky130_expected.calculation: With compensation capacitor Cc = 50 fF and load capacitor CL = 250 fF, closed-loop bandwidth is around 100-200 MHz, giving tau ~ 1.0 - 1.5 ns and settling to 1% in ~ 4-6 ns, corresponding directly to the 5 ns step transitions shown in Figure 26.35.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Fast settling is achievable due to the compact capacitance values (50 fF Cc, 250 fF CL) and high gm in SKY130.

step3_testbench.description: Simulation testbench for Figure 26.33 op-amp measuring DC operating point, open-loop gain via DC transfer sweep, common-mode voltage, output swing, and closed-loop transient step response.
